{
  "dataset_name": "bank_marketing",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3.1-pro-preview",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "age_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized age using training set mean and standard deviation to provide a smooth continuous feature for linear margins.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "demographic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the linear SVM to apply a consistent weight to age deviations from the mean.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 40.145) / 10.404"
    },
    {
      "name": "duration_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed call duration to compress the long tail and provide a more linear relationship with the outcome.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 9.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces the influence of extreme outliers in call duration, improving the stability of the SVM margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "medium",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(duration)"
    },
    {
      "name": "campaign_penalty",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "A capped and scaled penalty for excessive contacts during the current campaign.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "contact_history",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the diminishing or negative returns of over-contacting a client in a linear-friendly bounded format.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(campaign - 1, 0, 10) / 10.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "pdays_contacted_recently",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator of whether the client was contacted in a previous campaign (pdays < 999).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "contact_history",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a clear, linearly separable flag for clients with a recent contact history.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(pdays < 999, 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "previous_contact_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of previous contacts to current campaign contacts.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "contact_history",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights clients who have a history of engagement relative to the current effort, useful for linear weighting.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "previous / np.maximum(campaign, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "economic_stress_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "A composite index combining normalized employment variation rate and euribor 3-month rate.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "macroeconomic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates correlated macroeconomic indicators into a single smooth feature, reducing multicollinearity for the SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(emp.var.rate - (-3.4)) / 4.8 + (euribor3m - 0.634) / 4.336"
    },
    {
      "name": "employment_variation_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized employment variation rate.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "macroeconomic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Puts the employment variation rate on a standard scale, preventing it from dominating other features in the SVM objective.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(emp.var.rate - 0.081) / 1.570"
    },
    {
      "name": "consumer_confidence_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized consumer confidence index.",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "macroeconomic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a zero-centered, unit-variance feature for consumer confidence, ideal for linear model regularization.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(cons.conf.idx - (-40.49)) / 4.62"
    },
    {
      "name": "contact_intensity_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of how intensely the client has been contacted, considering both current campaign and previous contacts.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "contact_history",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures non-linear nuances in contact fatigue that simple formulas might miss, providing a smooth severity measure.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "client_stability_index",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic evaluation of the client's socio-economic stability based on age, job, marital status, and education.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "demographic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Translates categorical demographic variables into a continuous, linearly separable stability score.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "macroeconomic_favorability",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic judgment of how favorable the macroeconomic indicators (employment rate, consumer price index, consumer confidence, euribor) are for financial commitments.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "macroeconomic",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic, continuous projection of the economic climate's impact on client decision-making.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "engagement_quality_estimate",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic estimation of the quality of the client's engagement based on call duration, previous outcomes, and contact history.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Synthesizes interaction metrics into a single continuous quality score, highly informative for the SVM decision boundary.",
      "leakage_risk": "medium",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
